stem.text: Methanoic acid, $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$, and hydrocyanic acid, $\text{HCN}$, can both behave as acids.
A solution of methanoic acid has a lower pH than a solution of hydrocyanic acid of the same concentration.

items: $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$ molecules dissociate more fully than $\text{HCN}$ molecules do.
Each $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$ molecule has two hydrogen atoms; each $\text{HCN}$ molecule only has one.
Methanoic acid is a weaker acid than hydrocyanic acid.
